headlines.title: What T-Mobile US Bears Saw Before The Fall
headlines.summary: T-Mobile US spent the year in the headlines, from Starlink’s spectrum grabs to merger talk around its parent, but the share price told a different story. For T-Mobile US shareholders, the loss over the past year was 32.0%, including dividends. If you had bought on 26 October 2025, expecting 5G leadership, fiber expansion and rising margins to be rewarded, what did that original thesis miss about competitive risk and capital intensity? The easy part of this move is behind T-Mobile US.

headlines.title: What Does T Mobile US (TMUS) Winning Network Honors And Launching T Mix Mean?
headlines.summary: T-Mobile US (NasdaqGS:TMUS) was named U.S. Mobile Network Test Champion for Q3 2026, recognizing network quality and AI readiness. The carrier introduced new T-Mix wireless plans that let customers choose and swap bundled benefits such as streaming and gaming perks. Management is positioning T-Mix as a customizable lineup that aims to broaden appeal across different usage patterns and household setups.

headlines.title: P3 names T-Mobile the Mobile Network Test Champion in the United States for Q3 2026
headlines.summary: Today, independent telecommunications consultancy P3 awarded T-Mobile the title of P3 Mobile Network Test Champion in the United States for Q3 2026 following a comprehensive benchmark analysis of mobile network performance across the United States. Following its win in Q2 2026, T-Mobile once again ranks first overall and is the performance leader in all 13 categories.

description: T-Mobile US, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides wireless communications services in the United States, Puerto Rico, and the United States Virgin Islands. The company offers voice, messaging, and data services to postpaid, prepaid, and wholesale and other services customers. It also provides wireless devices, including smartphones, wearables, tablets, home broadband gateways, headsets, and other mobile communication devices, as well as accessories; financing through equipment installment plans; reinsurance for device insurance policies and extended warranty contracts. The company offers services under the T-Mobile, Metro by T-Mobile, and Mint Mobile brands through its owned and operated retail stores, customer care channels, national retailers, and its websites, as well as through T-Mobile, Metro by T-Mobile, and Mint Mobile apps. It also sells devices to dealers and other third-party distributors for resale through independent third-party retail outlets and various third-party websites. It has 700 MHz wireless spectrum licenses. The company was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Bellevue, Washington. T-Mobile US, Inc. operates as a subsidiary of Deutsche Telekom AG.
